document_dispositions.rationale: Full AMD newsroom transport reviewed. Four distinct CUSTOMER_OFFICIAL corroboration facts were extracted for the Samsung-AMD AI-memory MOU, named MI455X HBM4 supply alignment, AMD CEO technical-platform confirmation, and historical MI350X/MI355X HBM3E partnership. Foundry discussion, general boilerplate, duplicate page headers, product marketing, and unsupported purchase price, volume, duration, allocation, cancellation, contract, or HBM-only revenue claims were excluded.

facts.economic_mechanism: AMD 공식 뉴스룸은 삼성전자와 AMD가 차세대 AI 메모리·컴퓨팅 기술의 전략적 협력을 확대하는 MOU를 체결했다고 독립적으로 확인한다. 이는 기술·전략 관계의 CUSTOMER_OFFICIAL corroboration이며 구매계약이나 확정 공급조건을 뜻하지 않는다.
facts.exact_quote: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. today announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with AMD to expand their strategic collaboration on next-generation AI memory and computing technologies.
facts.materiality_rationale: The current information-confidence gap specifically asks for AMD-official corroboration of Samsung's named AI-memory relationship. This customer-official MOU confirmation changes source independence without adding purchase economics.
facts.normalized_object: AMD-official confirmation of Samsung-AMD next-generation AI memory strategic collaboration MOU
facts.subject: 삼성전자와 AMD의 차세대 AI 메모리 전략적 협력 MOU
facts.value: MOU signed to expand strategic collaboration on next-generation AI memory and computing technologies

facts.economic_mechanism: AMD 공식 뉴스룸은 MOU 아래 양사가 차세대 AMD Instinct MI455X용 primary HBM4 supply에 맞춰 협력한다고 확인한다. 명명 고객·제품의 미래 공급 가시성을 독립적으로 보강하지만 MOU 기반 정렬이므로 확정 구매계약, 물량, 가격, 기간 또는 취소조건으로 승격하지 않는다.
facts.exact_quote: Under the MOU, Samsung and AMD will align on primary HBM4 supply for the next-generation AMD AI accelerator, the AMD Instinct MI455X GPU, as well as advanced DRAM solutions for 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPUs, codenamed “Venice.”
facts.materiality_rationale: This is the requested customer-official confirmation of Samsung's named HBM4 role. It is material to information confidence and future visibility while remaining explicitly non-quantified and non-binding beyond the MOU language.
facts.normalized_object: AMD-official MOU-based primary HBM4 supply alignment for MI455X with commercial terms undisclosed

facts.exact_quote: We are thrilled to expand our work with Samsung, bringing together their leadership in advanced memory with our Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs and rack-scale platforms.
